messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The job scheduler depends on the flags service for per-job kill switches; if the flags service is down, the job scheduler is down. [valid 2025-03-28 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-28]
- Billing-api depends on the flags service as of 2025-10-21. [valid 2025-10-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-10-21]
- Clients will cache feature-flag evaluations from the flags service for 30 seconds as of 2025-08-20. [decision; valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- The job scheduler has a deploy window on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. [constraint; valid 2025-08-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-08-08]
    earlier: The job scheduler can be released on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC; any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-03-21 to 2025-08-08; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-21]

    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]

- Team Dune noticed on 2025-09-18 that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-09-18 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-18]
- On 2026-05-01, the Cinder team observed that the flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01-2]
- The Postgres 14 pin on Ledger lifts when the partitioning work finishes. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- The flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of the requests were identical. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Atlas goes to Tomasz. [decision; valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The first on-call rotation for Team Dune goes to Farah. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-13]
- The first on-call rotation for team Ember goes to Oskar. [decision; valid 2025-01-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-13]
- Boreal reported at standup on 2026-02-04 that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2026-02-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-04]
- Diego takes the first on-call shift of the year for Cinder. [decision; valid 2025-01-16 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-16]
- On 2026-03-16, Ember noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
- On 2026-04-29, Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-29]
- Billing-api depends on Ledger to work. [constraint; valid 2026-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-05]
- Ledger depends on the authentication gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-14 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-14]

- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-03]
